comment: The sixteen frequency ratios are listed at addiction.cpp:95: 1, 1.2, 1.25 and 1.5 for the first harmonic and the same set times 2, 3 and 4 for the others. Each level is the knob plus the jack times 0.2, unclamped (addiction.cpp:121). The knob defaults come from a four-entry table read with a one-place rotation (addiction.cpp:75, :85), so the first knob of each row starts at 0.7 and the fourth at 1.
